name: core_piece
usage: Represents a standard liquid unit that players sort into matching containers to complete puzzle levels.
prompt: One isolated transparent sprite of a cylindrical liquid container piece, showing vibrant, layered liquid inside, smooth glass material, bright saturated colors, rounded top view, playful casual mobile game style, clean edges, transparent background

name: special_piece
usage: Acts as a unique liquid unit with special effects that can clear obstacles or trigger combos in the puzzle.
prompt: One isolated transparent sprite of a special liquid piece with glowing, swirling patterns, semi-transparent gel texture, jewel-toned palette, dynamic tilted angle, whimsical casual mobile game feel, transparent background

name: blocker_piece
usage: Serves as a static obstacle that prevents liquid from moving until players remove it through gameplay mechanics.
prompt: One isolated transparent sprite of a solid blocker piece, jagged crystalline shape, opaque stone material with cracks, muted earthy colors, top-down perspective, casual mobile puzzle style, transparent background

name: hint_icon
usage: Provides players a visual cue for potential moves, assisting progression when they are stuck on a level.
prompt: One isolated transparent sprite of a glowing hint icon, circular shape with subtle sparkle highlights, bright accent color palette, angled front view, playful and readable, casual mobile game style, transparent background

name: board_scene
usage: Displays the main puzzle board where players arrange liquid pieces to solve levels and progress through the game.
prompt: Opaque gameplay background of a colorful liquid sorting board, top-down view with clear container slots, subtle depth layers, soft ambient lighting, playful props like spilled droplets and counters, safe space for piece placement, casual mobile puzzle atmosphere

name: premium_board
usage: Represents a visually enhanced board used for premium or special levels, offering a richer visual experience during puzzles.
prompt: Opaque gameplay background of an upgraded premium liquid sorting board, top-down layout with ornate container holders, polished reflective surfaces, bright lighting highlights, extra decorative props like floating sparkles and metallic trims, clear safe zones for gameplay, casual mobile game style
